description_en: Bhagavān Coka Bāhāḥ is located to the north of Bu Bāhāḥ (LAL0440) and can be accessed via a narrow alley to the right of Bu Bāhāḥ’sdigichẽ. Thisbāhāḥstands inside a courtyard that measures 10 m × 4.6 m.The main shrine faces north and is attached to the southern boundary wall of the courtyard. The structure is built on a double plinth and has a timber lattice that covers the main sanctum. The tiered temple has two layers of solid roofs surmounted by a half-bell-shaped dome attached to the back wall and astūpaas the pinnacle. Two small stone lions guard the main door to the temple. Inside, a stone statue of Akṣobhya is enshrined in the sanctum. The current statue was consecrated a few years ago after the loss of the previous one. Behind the temple, one can find four small niches. The pair on the right-hand side contain statues of Tārā and Mahākāla, whilst one of the left niches houses a statue of Gaṇeśa. The fourth niche is currently empty. A few years ago, there was a bell on the eastern side of the temple. This is now kept in the house of asaṅgha-member.The main courtyard has a smaller sunken courtyard in front of the temple structure; this measures 5.6 m × 3.6 m in size. Asmall dharmadhātujinālaya caitya(1.3 m high) is also located in front of the temple and was established in 1898. Thebāhāḥis surrounded by residential buildings on all four sides. The building at the northern wing is in ruins, though the other buildings are intact.Thisbāhāḥwas established by Ratnarāja Vajrācārya in 1872. The priest family of Bu Bāhāḥ performs the daily worship and other rituals associated with thebāhāḥ.
description_ne: यो बु बाहा: (LAL0440) को शाखा विहार हो । बाहा:को क्वा:पा:द्य:को रूपमा ढुंगाको अक्षोभ्य स्थापना गरिएको छ । केही वर्ष अगाडि पुरानो मूर्ति चोरी भएपछि यो नयाँ स्थापना गरिएको मूर्ति हो । गर्भगृहको ढोका अगाडि एक जोडी सिंहको मूर्ति स्थापना गरिएको छ । मन्दिरको दायाँबायाँ दुई-दुईवटा गवाक्ष बनाइएका छन् । मन्दिरको पूर्वतिर रहेका दुई गवाक्षमध्ये एउटा खाली नै रहेको छ भने एउटामा गणेशको मूर्ति स्थापना गरिएको छ । मन्दिरको पश्चिममा रहेका गवाक्षहरूमा तारा र महाकालको मूर्ति स्थापना गरिएको छ । पहिले मन्दिरको पूर्वमा काठको खम्बा सहितको घण्टा स्थापना गरिएको थियो । खम्बा जीर्ण भएपछि सुरक्षाको लागि घण्टालाई एकजना संघ-सदस्यको घरमा राखिएको छ । मन्दिर परिसरमा नेसं १०१८ मा स्थापना गरिएको धातुको धर्मधातुजिनालय चैत्य स्थापना गरिएको छ ।यो बाहा: नेसं ९९२ मा रत्नराज वज्राचार्यले स्थापना गरेका थिए । बु बाहा:को मूलदुवा (पुरोहित) समूहको वज्राचार्य परिवारबाट यो बाहा: सञ्चालन भइरहेको छ । यहाँ दैनिक पूजा लगायत वंश (ब्रह्मू गुठी) र वर्षवर्द्धन पूजा पनि संचालन भइरहेका छन् ।
monument_assessment: Slightly damaged (minor damages such as minor cracks, plants, missing stones in plinths)

historical_events.event_description: Before thebāhāḥwas established, the Mūladuvā clan had already established aguṭhīto organise worships and feasts.

historical_events.event_name: Donation of bell, toraṇa and throne
historical_events.event_description: Ratnarāja Vajrācārya, the founder of thebāhāḥ, donated a bell, a lion’s throne for the main deity, and a gildedtoraṇa.
Ratnarāja Vajrācārya, a member of Mūladuvā, founded thisbāhāḥ.

Before thisbāhāḥwas established, Dhana Thakũ had consecrated statues of Dīpaṅkara and Tārā in memory of her late husband Bhājudeva. She also installed aguṭhīto organise the worship, feast and donation ceremony (pañcadāna) on the 8th day of the bright fortnight of Bhādra.
